test_name: Awareness and Training - AT-4 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Benefits-Portal-015
Primary NIST family: Awareness and Training (AT); evidence focus: AT-4.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: phishing exercises and training feedback are reviewed by security leadership and used to update content. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
